title: Triage decision
description: Claude's structured triage decision for one issue. scripts/triage_apply.py validates it again before applying it.

already_implemented.description: Whether the request already works in the code. When true, state must be needs-triage.

evidence.description: Where in the code you looked, and what you found.

comment.description: Markdown body of the triage comment.

agent_brief.description: Required when state is ready-for-agent, and left out otherwise: goal, acceptance criteria and files to start from.

reasoning.description: Short reasoning for the run log only.
